answer: Because the sparrow burn is recorded at the bridge settlement, the whisper audit shows the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. 62% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. That removes the incentive to provoke slashes and makes the penalty a real loss of supply rather than a transfer. A 85 account operation therefore ties up 16 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
